let memory =
    LIST[int](
        program.split([' '], System.StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
            |> map(word => int.parse(word)))

let ip mut = 0

while ip >= 0 do
    let (a, b, c) = (memory[ip], memory[ip + 1], memory[ip + 2])
    ip = ip + 3

    if a == -1 then
        memory[b] = Std.read()
    elif b == -1 then
        Std.write(cast char(memory[a]))
    else
        memory[b] = memory[b] - memory[a]
